episodes.title: Rosey the Robot
episodes.summary: Jane insists that she needs a robot maid. They take in Rosey, who's attitude and expense, puts George's job on the line.

episodes.title: A Date with Jet Screamer
episodes.summary: Pop star 'Jet Screamer' organizes a quiz, first prize: a date with the celebrity himself. George tries to make sure Judy won't win, but Judy is the lucky girl. Without her knowing it George acts as a chaperone.

episodes.title: The Space Car
episodes.summary: George and Jane go shopping at Molecular Motors. The Supersonic Suburbanite turns out to be too much for them so the buy a car similar to their old model. They get mixed up with bad guy Knuckles Nuclear and his gun Moll.

episodes.title: The Coming of Astro
episodes.summary: George says no to having Astro, a stray dog, but thinks a robot dog will be better for the family, so gets 'Lectronimo. When a burglar breaks in, though, Astro proves to be the better dog.

episodes.title: Jetson's Nite Out
episodes.summary: George Jetson and his boss Cosmo Spacely attend a robot football game. George fools his wife into thinking he's working late so that he won't be able to attend a PTA meeting.

episodes.title: The Good Little Scouts
episodes.summary: George is too busy at work to help Elroy with his Space Cub training, but when his boss's son is in the same troop, he is forced to go on a hiking trip with them to the Moon.

episodes.title: The Flying Suit
episodes.summary: George thinks Elroy has made flying pills, so he takes it to Spacely to turn into a fortune and put Spacely's competitor, Cogswell, out of business for good.

episodes.title: Rosey's Boyfriend
episodes.summary: Judy and Rosey find boyfriends. The problem with love is that you're either up or down ... and the animated junk pile being Henry's assistant gets a little confused.

episodes.title: Elroy's TV Show
episodes.summary: A TV show producer discovers Elroy and Astro in the park, and casts them in a brand new, original series: "The Adventures of Spaceboy Zoom and His Dog, Astro".

episodes.title: Uniblab
episodes.summary: Mr. Spacely pays for a new, expensive robot to take George's promotion as office supervisor, who double crosses him at every turn.

episodes.title: A Visit from Grandpa
episodes.summary: George's father visits. On his way he fixes a lady's vehicle, they exchange addresses. Because of some miscommunication the Jetson family think they got involved while in reality grandpa just baby-sits for someone else.

episodes.title: Astro's Top Secret
episodes.summary: Astro is given the third degree when Cogswell suspects him to be party to a new Spacely Sprockets invention after he swallows Elroy's flying toy car.

episodes.title: Las Venus
episodes.summary: George and Jane visit Las Venus for gambling and entertainment. The trip is paid by Spacely because George has to try to sell some sprockets to a female client. Now George has to please his wife and the client.

episodes.title: Elroy's Pal
episodes.summary: When Nimbus the Great is too sick to meet Elroy in a contest he won, George takes his place.

episodes.title: Test Pilot
episodes.summary: After George thinks he doesn't have long to live, he volunteers to test out a prototype jacket that's supposed to be indestructible jacket.

episodes.title: Millionaire Astro
episodes.summary: Astro turns out to be the long-lost dog of a millionaire. The Jetsons have to let Astro go. Now Astro has everything a dog can wish for, except the love of the Jetson family.

episodes.title: The Little Man
episodes.summary: George accidentally goes through the Minavac, which shrinks him down to six inches high. The only way he can return to regular size, is by stealing a cog from Cogswell Cogs.

episodes.title: Jane's Driving Lesson
episodes.summary: Jane goes for driving lessons to get a second car and ends up with Knuckles Nuclear as her driving instructor.

episodes.title: G.I. Jetson
episodes.summary: George is enrolled in the space guard reserves, where his superiors are Spacely and the conniving Uniblab.

episodes.title: Miss Solar System
episodes.summary: Jane decides to enter the Miss Solar System contest without George knowing. However, Spacely Sprockets is sponsoring the contest. George & Mr. Spacely are judges, but Mrs. Spacely removes her husband from the judges' stand & George is the "Mystery Judge".

episodes.title: Private Property
episodes.summary: When a new Cogswell Cogs office opens next door to Spacely Sprockets, George is put in charge of the property dispute, only to discover Spacely Sprockets is on Cogswell's property. Later retitled No Space for Sprockets.

episodes.title: Dude Planet
episodes.summary: Burnt out on housework, Jane takes a retreat at a futuristic dude ranch. (Note: Astro didn't appear in this episode, however he was replaced by an unnamed cat.)

episodes.title: TV or Not TV
episodes.summary: When George and Astro witness the shooting of a crime TV show called "The Naked Planet" (take on The Naked City), they think they've witnessed a real robbery and go into hiding to keep from being shot for knowing too much.

episodes.title: Elroy's Mob
episodes.summary: Elroy accidentally gets a report card mix-up and gets 4 D's, an F, and an "H", so when his dad punishes him, he and Astro run away and join a mob run by Muggsy Megaton. Note: This episode featured a sort-of crossover with The Flintstones; A boy in Elroy's class—Kenny Countdown—has a TV Wristwatch which is showing part of a Flintstones episode, before it is confiscated by Ms. Brainmocker, the class's robot teacher.

episodes.title: Elroy Meets Orbitty
episodes.summary: Elroy finds a weird rock and takes it home, where it hatches into a furry little creature that the family adopts, although Astro doesn't feel as loved anymore and runs away, getting taken to the dogpound in the process.

episodes.title: Rosie Come Home
episodes.summary: Rosie is in need of a replacement program, which she overhears and thinks she's being replaced, so she leaves the Jetsons.

episodes.title: Solar Snoops
episodes.summary: When Cogswell sends in a spy to Spacely Space Sprockets to steal Spacely's new chocolate microchip cookie, Spacely sends George—disguised as Georgina Jetstream—to act as Cogswell's new secretary to get it back.

episodes.title: Judy's Birthday Surprise
episodes.summary: Finding herself alone on the night of her 16th birthday, Judy tells her robot diary all about the events that lead up to her special day.

episodes.title: SuperGeorge
episodes.summary: A machine that can make thoughts a reality breaks while George imagines himself as a superhero. Believing it to be permanent, he becomes a wrestler after his super strength gets him in trouble with Spacely.

episodes.title: Family Fallout
episodes.summary: George Jetson and his family competes against Cosmo Spacely and his family in the game show "Family Fallout". Mr. Spacely is determined to keep George from participating in the game show.

episodes.title: Instant Replay
episodes.summary: George gets a device that can rewind time back to any moment and make it better; but his jealousy of an old rival gets the better of him and accidentally removes his marriage to Jane.

episodes.title: Fugitive Fleas
episodes.summary: Circus Moon Fleas quit their job and take refuge on Astro.

episodes.title: S.M.A.S.H.
episodes.summary: Mr. Spacely leaves his brand new fancy car to George while he is on a business trip. Judy and Elroy take George's car for a ride, so Jane has to take Mr. Spacely's to go to the mall. Jane wrecks the car completely while she tries to find a parking space.

episodes.title: One Strike, You're Out
episodes.summary: George is talked into going on a workers' strike; he accidentally breaks Elroy's robot for the Robot Olympics, so he gets inside and acts out the contests himself.

episodes.title: Mother's Day for Rosie
episodes.summary: George tries to cheer Rosie up by getting a picture of her previous model, her "mother", but being an old model, it proves difficult to find.

episodes.title: S'No Relative
episodes.summary: The Jetson's are expecting a visit from a cousin. Meanwhile, a alien iceman escapes from a doctor and ends up at the Jetson's home and is mistaken for the cousin.

episodes.title: Dance Time
episodes.summary: After Judy becomes shamed about George's dancing style, George ends up taking dancing lessons. He then runs into a inventor who gives him a pair of experimental dancing shoes so he can impress his daughter.

episodes.title: Judy Takes Off
episodes.summary: George tries to get Judy away from the dangers of teenage boys by sending her to her wallflower cousin Melissa for a few days, but doesn't count on Melissa becoming a wild child.

episodes.title: Winner Takes All
episodes.summary: George is forced to prove his brawn when Spacely is pitted against Cogswell in an Olympic-themed contest. But he must also keep his brains intact if he is to uncover Mr. Cogswell's cheating twins.

episodes.title: The Mirrormorph
episodes.summary: An alien-like clay substance, which can silently mimic those who touch it, causes great confusion and chaos among the citizens of Orbit City.

episodes.title: The Cosmic Courtship of George and Jane
episodes.summary: Just as George upsets Jane for forgetting their anniversary, they find out that they weren't officially married all these years!

episodes.title: High Moon
episodes.summary: Elroy's idolization of a TV action star, gets George to take the whole family to the "Old West" parts of space, where his great-great-grandfather was a real hero. But a rival's descendant has a score to settle.

episodes.title: Hi-Tech Wreck
episodes.summary: A successful investment opportunity between Spacely Sprockets and a major corporation, rides on George keeping R.U.D.I. from overloading, which, of course, means the end of his job, if he fails.

episodes.title: Little Bundle of Trouble
episodes.summary: A jewel thief lays low by disguising himself as baby and dropping himself off at the Jetsons' doorstep.

episodes.title: Elroy in Wonderland
episodes.summary: While on vacation, Elroy runs away with Astro, after the strict robotic activities director forbids Astro to be with the family, who seem to be taking the robot's side over Elroy. During this time, he runs into a secret, trash zone where obsolete, living tools rebel against the dictator, the Wicked Wrench of the West.

episodes.title: The Swiss Family Jetson
episodes.summary: City life has become too much for George, so after being laid off from work, he and the family set off to live a simpler life as farmers on a far-off planetoid.

episodes.title: Rip-Off Rosie
episodes.summary: After accidentally consuming a bad lugnut, Rosie's personality malfunctions, transforming her into a kleptomaniac.

episodes.title: Fantasy Planet
episodes.summary: Having become overly stressed and overly worked, the Jetsons discover Fantasy Planet, which can provide for them their ultimate desires.

episodes.title: Space Bong
episodes.summary: A case of mistaken identity leads George to be confused for a secret agent, who is wanted by the evil organization S.N.E.A.K

episodes.title: Haunted Halloween
episodes.summary: After hearing a scary story from George, Orbitty believes a mad scientist is out to get him to add to his museum.

episodes.title: Astro's Big Moment
episodes.summary: George is caught in a difficult position as dog show judge, where he'll either lose the love of his family, his job, or even his life, if he doesn't choose the right dog to win.

episodes.title: Jetsons' Millions
episodes.summary: George's life takes a major turn, when he goes from taking on a second job to finding out he's a millionaire!

episodes.title: The Wrong Stuff
episodes.summary: Elroy becomes a celebrity after he and Astro accidentally board a rocket, which is programmed to land back to Earth in five years. However, due to interference with a black hole, they return quicker than expected, with some surprising results.

episodes.title: The Vacation
episodes.summary: While on a free cruise on the Love Rocket, George and Jane encounter old flames who are still burning a torch for the two. When George and Jane fail to turn them down, it's up to their kids to get rid of the old romances.

episodes.title: Team Spirit
episodes.summary: George becomes the star player in a baseball game between the Spacely Sprockets and Cogswell Cogs, which is otherwise filled with only robots.

episodes.title: Future Tense
episodes.summary: After finding out Jane's new sunglasses can foresee the immediate future, she and George turn to betting on horses, until they get into trouble with two shady-looking figures.

episodes.title: Far-Out Father
episodes.summary: While Elroy makes a class project about his father, George has to contend with Astro's spring fever, which has made him obsessed with the new neighborhood dog, Jezebel.

episodes.title: Dog Daze Afternoon
episodes.summary: A mix-up of computer disks between a new Spacely Sprockets transportation device and Elroy's dog training machine, makes programs George to act like a dog.

episodes.title: Grandpa and the Galactic Goldigger
episodes.summary: A case of mistaken identity ensues when a young, seductive con artist believes Grandpa Jetson is rich after using Mr. Spacely's credit card.

episodes.title: Robot's Revenge
episodes.summary: After being fired due to George's complaint, Ralph the robot turns all of robotkind against him.

episodes.title: To Tell the Truth
episodes.summary: George insists to Elroy that it's better to be honest with Jane, but finds it difficult to be honest himself with Jane, after postponing their date when he gets stuck on a moon with the alluring Bubbles Blastoff.

episodes.title: Boy George
episodes.summary: Feeling his age, George takes some youth potion, but the experimental concoction turns him into a child.

episodes.title: Judy's Elopement
episodes.summary: Due to gossip from Rosie, George believes Judy is eloping with Sam Spacely, Mr. Spacely, inept nephew. But she is really helping Sam secretly get hitched with Asteroid Cogswell, Mr. Cogswell's daughter.

episodes.title: The Century's Best
episodes.summary: After Orbitty gets randomly picked to decide who is the best person to represent the 21st century a thousand years later, each of the Jetson family vie for his attention by recounting to him a favorite moment in their lives.

episodes.title: A Jetson Christmas Carol
episodes.summary: As a result of showing his dislike of all things Christmas, three ghostly robotic apparitions visit the greedy Spacely to show him the error of his ways, from his past mistakes to what his current mistakes are and how it will affect his future.

episodes.title: Crime Games
episodes.summary: Due to interference with the TV, Elroy discovers that Mr. Cogswell's plant will be robbed by the Gridfather, which he is unable to convince George about. To appease him, George investigates anyway, which gets him into trouble with the law when the police think he's working with the Gridfather.

episodes.title: ASTROnomical I.Q.
episodes.summary: Elroy's new invention accidentally vastly increases Astro's intelligence being able to help George at the plant and other places, none of which last for long because Astro is still a dog. Elroy also feels put out due to Astro losing interest in playing with him.

episodes.title: 9 to 5 to 9
episodes.summary: In her attempt to buy a new car to impress a new boy, Judy takes on several different jobs, but the workload becomes so big, that the entire family have to pitch in.

episodes.title: Invisibly Yours, George
episodes.summary: George becomes the unwilling test subject for an experimental new stain remover, which turns him invisible.

episodes.title: Father/Daughter Dance
episodes.summary: Just when Judy couldn't be more humiliated by dancing with her father at the father/daughter dance, he has to cancel at the last minute and sends in Grandpa Jetson as a substitute dance partner.

episodes.title: Clean as a Hound's Tooth
episodes.summary: George finds out a toothache is the cause of his recent bad nights. He is giving a pair of experimental dentures that can temporarily relieve the pain, but finds out too late they're for dogs, making him spontaneously act like a dog.

episodes.title: Wedding Bells for Rosey
episodes.summary: The city is under sudden scrutiny of renewing every robot's particular component known as a B.E.B.O.P., which has put Mac in danger of being dismantled if he doesn't apply for one. Rosey finds a loophole through marriage, although she quickly regrets it once he starts getting in her way. This is also bad news Spacely Space Sprockets, but good news for Cogswell Cogs.

episodes.title: The Odd Pod
episodes.summary: George buys Jane a new plant called the Martian Creeper to win at the annual Garden Club show, but it has a mind of its own, and is impossible to get rid off.

episodes.title: Two Many Georges
episodes.summary: George gets a rare day-off, but its then filled with the needs of family. When he gets over tasked, he uses a cloning machine, which creates a duplicate of George, who does a much better job.

episodes.title: Spacely for a Day
episodes.summary: After Spacely is guilted into taking a thirty year long overdue vacation with his wife, he is forced to find a substitute to run his plant, with George fulfilling the requirements necessary. With Spacely out the way, Mr. Cogswell sees this as the perfect opportunity to ruin the company.
